# ISP Group LLC

> United States trading company registered in Florida. We find the producer,
> confirm it can legally ship to the destination country, buy the goods in our
> own name and deliver them to the buyer’s port. Principal, not a broker.

Contact: info@ispgroupgc.com · https://ispgroupgc.com/contact

## What we do

- [What we do](https://ispgroupgc.com/services): Each step of a cross-border purchase as a named piece of work: specification, producer verification, landed costing, contracting, inspection and documents.
- [Twenty years of supply work](https://ispgroupgc.com/experience): Twenty years of supply work: container programmes out of China, discharge onto unequipped Russian shores, food and equipment into the European Union.
- [About ISP Group](https://ispgroupgc.com/about): United States trading company. We buy in our own name, verify producers before quoting and deliver on agreed Incoterms.
- [How to verify a supplier is a factory](https://ispgroupgc.com/verify-supplier): Business licence, export right, scope of business and the bank account name: the checks that separate a factory from a trader.

## Supply categories

- [Building and finishing materials](https://ispgroupgc.com/building-materials): Stone, porcelain and ceramic tile, cement, insulation, sanitary ware and cable, bought against EN and ISO standards.
- [Industrial equipment and machinery](https://ispgroupgc.com/industrial-equipment): Production lines, compressors, pumps, generators and material handling, with mark, voltage and spares specified.
- [Tools, hardware and fasteners](https://ispgroupgc.com/tools-hardware): Power and hand tools, abrasives, measuring instruments and fixings, to specification or to brand, with the safety marks.
- [Metals and pipe](https://ispgroupgc.com/metals-pipe): Structural sections, sheet and plate, seamless and welded pipe, fittings and flanges to EN, ASTM or GOST, with EN 10204 mill certificates.
- [Paper, packaging and consumables](https://ispgroupgc.com/paper-packaging): Newsprint, kraft and containerboard in reels, corrugated packaging, cleaning and facility consumables, workwear and protective equipment.
- [Food and agricultural goods](https://ispgroupgc.com/food-agricultural): Frozen and chilled protein, bulk staples, food ingredients and branded beverages. Protein and staples are handled under veterinary and sanitary certification for the destination country.
- [What we supply](https://ispgroupgc.com/supply): Six categories where we already have producer relationships and a documented lane: building materials, industrial equipment, tools, metals and pipe, paper, food.

## Trade corridors

- [Trade corridors we run](https://ispgroupgc.com/corridors): Four routes we run end to end, with the producers, forwarder, customs broker and document set already in place on each one.
- [Frozen food into Lomé and Cotonou](https://ispgroupgc.com/west-africa): Frozen poultry, staples and consumables into Lomé and Cotonou: veterinary admissibility, cut nomenclature, reefer cold chain and payment terms.
- [Durban to Gaborone and SADC supply](https://ispgroupgc.com/southern-africa): Paper, packaging and industrial supply through Durban into Botswana and SADC: why SACU is not SADC, transit paperwork, reels and DAP pricing.
- [China sourcing and container shipping](https://ispgroupgc.com/china): Sourcing from China: how we separate a factory from a trading company, write a specification that binds, inspect before loading and stage the payment.
- [Stone and building materials from Türkiye](https://ispgroupgc.com/turkiye): Natural stone, tile and building materials from Türkiye to the United States: block against slab, grading, crating, HTS classification and the duty check.

## Guides

- [Incoterms 2020 explained](https://ispgroupgc.com/incoterms): FOB, CFR, CIF, FCA, DAP and the rest in plain language: who pays, where risk passes, which rules are sea-only, and why CFR and CIF split cost from risk.
- [What a landed price must include](https://ispgroupgc.com/landed-price): Every line between a factory price and your own gate: freight, surcharges, insurance, terminal handling, duty, broker, inland leg.
- [Who is liable for the HS code](https://ispgroupgc.com/hs-code): The importer of record is liable for the tariff code, not the seller who typed it. What a wrong one costs and how to fix it in advance.
- [A letter of credit at sight](https://ispgroupgc.com/letter-of-credit): What a documentary credit protects, why banks deal in documents and not goods, what a discrepancy costs, and when a letter of credit is the wrong instrument.
- [Bill of lading and telex release](https://ispgroupgc.com/bill-of-lading): Receipt, contract of carriage and document of title in one piece of paper. Originals, seaway bills, telex release and what happens when cargo beats documents.
- [Certificates of origin](https://ispgroupgc.com/certificate-of-origin): Who issues a certificate of origin, what preferential and non-preferential mean, how rules of origin are actually tested, and the mistakes that void one.
- [The proforma invoice](https://ispgroupgc.com/proforma-invoice): A proforma invoice is an offer, not an accounting document. What belongs on it, how it differs from a commercial invoice, and the single line that catches fraud.
- [Demurrage and detention](https://ispgroupgc.com/demurrage-detention): Demurrage runs while the container sits in the terminal, detention while you have it outside. Free time, reefer rates, who pays and how to stop the clock.
- [ISPM 15: how a pallet stops a container](https://ispgroupgc.com/ispm-15): What ISPM 15 covers, the treatment codes, how to read the mark, which wood is exempt, and why the check belongs at loading rather than at arrival.
- [The trade remedy check before you order](https://ispgroupgc.com/antidumping-check): Why a cash deposit can exceed the value of the goods, how scope is defined, and why in the United States the deposit is not the final liability.
- [FCL, LCL and consolidation](https://ispgroupgc.com/container-loading): Container capacities, why dense cargo fills on weight, when LCL is false economy, and how consolidation keeps FCL economics.
- [How customs data shows the real price](https://ispgroupgc.com/customs-data-pricing): A quotation is what a seller wants. A customs unit value is what the market paid. Where to find the data, how to read it, and the four traps in it.
- [What a reefer programme requires](https://ispgroupgc.com/reefer-cold-chain): Set point, recorders, plug time at transhipment, pack format and the loading practice that decides whether a frozen consignment arrives saleable.
- [Wing, drumette, flat: four different products](https://ispgroupgc.com/poultry-cuts): Why a quotation for wings is not a quotation: whole wing, two-joint, drumette and mid-joint flat are four products with four prices, and tom is not hen.
- [Veterinary certificates for frozen meat](https://ispgroupgc.com/veterinary-certificate): Why an establishment number comes before a price, how export certification works for United States and European Union origin, and what to ask a seller first.
- [Guides to importing](https://ispgroupgc.com/guides): Plain answers to what comes up before a first order: Incoterms, landed price, supplier checks, letters of credit, HS codes.

## En français

- [ISP Group](https://ispgroupgc.com/fr): Société de négoce américaine. Nous trouvons des producteurs vérifiés, achetons en notre nom propre et livrons à votre port au prix rendu.
- [Afrique de l’Ouest](https://ispgroupgc.com/afrique-ouest): Conteneurs frigorifiques vers le Togo et le Bénin : agrément de l’établissement, découpes, chaîne du froid, paiement.
- [Certificat vétérinaire](https://ispgroupgc.com/certificat-veterinaire): Pourquoi le numéro d’agrément passe avant le prix, comment fonctionne la certification à l’export des États-Unis et de l’Union européenne.
- [Découpes de volaille](https://ispgroupgc.com/decoupes-volaille): Pourquoi une cotation pour « des ailes » n’est pas une cotation : aile entière, aile à deux phalanges, manchon et aileron sont quatre produits.
- [Contact ISP Group](https://ispgroupgc.com/contact-fr): Envoyez votre besoin : produit, quantité et port de destination suffisent. Bureau à North Miami Beach, Floride. Réponse sous un jour ouvré.
